safety_question: Before we touch anything: do you smell burning or gas, see smoke, sparks or flames, or feel a tingle or shock from it? Is there any water near a plug or cord?
stop_instructions: Stop. Don't try to fix this yourself.
Only if it is safe to reach, unplug it or switch off its breaker.
If you see smoke or flames, or smell gas, leave the area and call your emergency number.
Don't use it again until a qualified professional has checked it.

technician_only_topics.reason: Gas parts are never a DIY job.
Refrigerant and sealed-system work needs a licensed technician.
Internal electrical work is technician only.
